l: "No. 680925... playing back record..."
Development Log Entry 680925.
<< 680925 gou… kiroku wo saisei… >>

《増殖炉の試運転を実施…
不完全ながら23個体のクリスタル精製に成功…》

"Trial run of the proliferation furnace conducted...
though incomplete, refinement of 23 Crystal units was successful..."

Mitogenic reactor trial successful.
23 units of grade 3-C crystal produced.
<< zoushoku ro no shiunten wo jisshi… / <x=+25> fukanzen nagara 23 kotai no kurisutaru seisei ni seikou… >>

《増殖という生命の基本原理を応用…
理論の正しさが証明されたことで 今後は…》

"Applying the basic life principle of proliferation...
with the theory's correctness now proven, henceforth..."

Moving forward, all seeds fabricated
from inorganic material are to be replaced
with lab-grown organic specimens.
<< zoushoku toiu seimei no kihongenri wo ouyou… / <x=+25> riron no tadashisa ga shoumeisa retakotode kongo ha… >>

クリスタルの精製…
やはり ここでマザークリスタルをつくろうと…

Crystal refinement...
As I thought, they were trying to make a Mothercrystal here...

Organic specimens...
So they were turning living creatures into crystals.
kurisutaru no seisei… / yahari kokode mazaakurisutaru wotsukurouto…
飛空艇…こんなところに…
An airship... in a place like this...
I wonder if any are still capable of flight.
hikuutei… konnatokoroni…
《賢者の塔》からも飛び立っていたのか
So they were launching from the Sagespire too...
Mid will want to see this.
<< kenja no tou >> karamo tobi tatsu teitanoka

Development Log Entry 750501.
<< 750501 gou… kiroku wo saisei… >>

《マザークリスタル精製の過程で生まれた生体繊維は
魔導兵器への転用を実現…成功した…》

"The biofibers generated in the Mothercrystal refinement process
have been successfully repurposed for magitek weapons... it was a success..."

Average improvement of crystal resilience 492% when
biological core exhibits high aetherial congruity.

兵器競争において有利に立つことができるだろう…》

"By advancing further research hereafter,
we should be able to stand at an advantage in the arms race..."

Specimens with a congruity rating of seven or below
are to be sent to B Level for military repurposing.

Waste not, want not.
seitai sen'i toha ittai…

Initializing emergency subroutines.
Diverting reactor power.

What is this foul presence...
I think it's getting ready to receive us.

"Warning... emergency has occurred..."
Primary firewalls breached. Code Orange.

Bypassing safety protocols.
<< kinkyuujitai hassei… >>

Research staff are to proceed to the nearest white zone immediately.

Intruder alert. Intruder alert.

くそ  敵が襲ってくる…やるぞ…！
Damn. The enemy's coming... Here we go...!
I...think my powers have returned. You?
kuso teki ga osotsu tekuru… yaruzo…!

分かってる
まずはこいつらを片づけよう

I know.
Let's deal with these ones first.
The same. There's aether here. An abundance of it.
waka tteru / mazuhakoitsurawo katazu keyou
このゴブリンは…！
This Goblin is...!
More goblins.
kono goburin ha…!
外にいた奴らと同じだ…
Same as the ones outside...
So now we know where they got their weapons.
soto niita yatsu rato onaji da…
ここから現れたのか！
So this is where they came from!
But how long have they been hiding here?
kokokara araware tanoka!
ダスククリスタルが…こんなに…！
The Dusk Crystal... so much of it...!
Dusk crystals...everywhere.
dasukukurisutaru ga… konnani…!
出どころのようだな

Well, that's one mystery solved.
ido koronoyoudana
ということは…
Which means...

toiukotoha…
ああ  ここが《賢者の塔》に違いない

Yet. We still have plenty of tower to explore.
aa kokoga << kenja no tou >> ni chigai nai
さっきのが人造コアなら  あれが――
If that last one was an artificial core, then that is...
To think the Fallen built all this.
sakkinoga jinzou koa nara aregaaa
マザークリスタル代わりか

The knowledge they must have needed.
mazaakurisutaru kawari ka
信じられないよ
I can't believe it.
Knowledge now lost.
shinji rarenaiyo

ここは行き止まりのようだ
どこかに道は…

Looks like this is a dead end.
There must be a way somewhere...
If this is like every other Fallen ruin...
kokoha ikidomari noyouda / dokokani michi ha…
この辺りを探してみよう
Let's search around here.
Then there'll be a lift.
kono atari wo sagashi temiyou

Is this a lift...?
Onward and upward.
koreha shoukou ki ka…
この装置は…
This device...
Any idea what those are?
kono souchi ha…
中にいるのは魔物…でも  何を…
There are monsters inside... but what for...
They seem to be containers of some sort. Or perhaps...
nakani irunoha mamono… demo naniwo…

マザークリスタルをつくるのに必要だったのかしら…
不気味ね…

I wonder if they were needed to make the Mothercrystal...
It's unsettling...

Cages. Like some sort of twisted menagerie.
But why here?
mazaakurisutaru wotsukurunoni hitsuyou dattanokashira… / bukimi ne…
こいつら  まだ生きてるぞ…！
These things are still alive...!
Wait, they're still alive!?
koitsura mada iki teruzo…!
襲ってくる！　ふたりとも気をつけて！
They're coming! Both of you, watch out!
But this tower is more than fifteen centuries old!
osotsu tekuru! futaritomo kiwo tsukete!
空の文明の民は  なぜこんな魔物たちを…
Why would the people of the Fallen make such monsters...

If they built this place to grow crystals,
why imprison creatures here?
sora no bunmei no tami ha nazekonna mamono tachiwo…
この遺物…どうやら動いているようだ…
This relic... it seems to be working...
That device. It glows just like the doors.
kono ibutsu… douyara ugoi teiruyouda…
…駄目か
...No good.
Nothing.
… dame ka
別の道を探しましょう
Let's look for another way.
Then we'll have to find another way.
betsuno michi wo sagashi mashou

見て ふたりとも…
色々な魔物が保管されてる…

Look, both of you...
All sorts of monsters are being kept here...

I doubt some of the creatures in these cages
have been seen in Valisthea for a thousand years.
mite futaritomo… / iroiro na mamono ga hokan sareteru…
クリスタルとどんな関係が…？
What connection could they have to the Crystal...?
Well, here's to a thousand more.
kurisutaru todonna kankei ga…？
こいつ  さっきの化け物と…！
This one... it's like that monster from before...!
Of course they built more than one.
koitsu sakkino bakemono to…!
ああ  油断できる相手じゃなさそうだ…！
Yeah. It doesn't look like a foe we can let our guard down against...!
Though it appears this incarnation can fly!
aa yudan dekiru aite janasasouda…!
何とか倒したか…
We managed to kill it, somehow...
And that makes two.
nantoka taoshi taka…
ただの魔物とは思えないわ…
I don't think it's any ordinary monster...
Yes, but of how many?
tadano mamono toha omoe naiwa…

黒い魔物…
まさか これもつくられた…？

A black monster...
Don't tell me this one was made too...?

That depends on how determined they were
to conceal their activities.
kuroi mamono… / masaka koremotsukurareta…？

この昇降機も生きてる
これを使って何とか先へ行けそうだ

This lift works too.
We should be able to use it to get further in.

why not simply disable the lift?
kono shoukou ki mo iki teru / korewo tsukatte nantoka saki he ike souda
ああ  このまま進もう
Yeah. Let's keep going.
What are you suggesting, Joshua?
aa konomama susumo u
コアはどこかしら…
I wonder where the core is...
That it's herding us.
koa hadokokashira…
ねえ  あれを見て…！
Hey, look at that...!
There's an entire fleet...
nee arewo mite…!

Hostile life has entered the airship hangar bay... Eliminate...

Anomalous activity detected in Hangar Bay.
Mobilizing aegis units.
<< tekitai seimei ga hikuutei kakunou kukaku ni shinnyuu… haijo seyo… >>
敵だ  兄さん！
Enemies, nii-san!
We're being watched.
teki da niisan!
ここまで来たなら  なぎ倒すまでだ！
Now that we've come this far, we mow them down!
Then let's show them what we're capable of.
kokomade kita nara nagi taosu madeda!
気をつけて  何が起こるかわからない
Be careful. There's no telling what could happen.
Perhaps the rest of the cages will open now.
kiwo tsukete nani ga oko rukawakaranai

Yeah, I know.
Don't tempt fate, Joshua.
aa waka tteru

Let's stay alert to what's around us.
Forgive me, Brother. They...may not?
atari no keikai wo okotara naiyounishiyou

What is this black stuff...?

myaku utsu youni ugoi teiru…

This is... there's black stuff everywhere...

Or is it some sort of...corruption?
koitsuha… sokora nakani kuroi monoga…
それに…まるで  生きてるみたいだ…
And... it's as if it's alive...

I don't know. But wouldn't you say
it looks oddly familiar?
soreni… marude iki terumitaida…
タウルス族…！？
The Taurus tribe...!?
A minotaur...
taurusu zoku…!？
これもゴブリンと同じ大昔の…！？
This is from ancient times too, like the Goblin...!?
Born over fifteen hundred years ago, yes.
koremo goburin to onaji oomukashi no…!？
また遺物が…調べてみよう

Ah, there's another one of those devices.
mata ibutsu ga… shirabe temiyou

Don't tell me this black stuff is the monsters'...?
If all of this truly was the work of the Fallen...
masaka kono kuroi monotte mamono tachino…？

おそらく…
黒い魔物はここでつくられたんだ

Most likely...
The black monsters were made here.

Then they were closer to attaining godhood
than we ever imagined.
osoraku… / kuroi mamono hakokodetsukuraretanda
魔物をつくり出すか…
So they make monsters...
No wonder Ultima struck them down.
mamono wotsukuri dasu ka…
またこいつか…！

They built an army!
matakoitsuka…!

あれを！
That one!
There!
arewo!
人造コアだ！

jinzou koa da!

そうだな…

oorudohiru zousenjo ka…

Let's go, both of you.
Lead the way, Brother!
iko u futaritomo

はあ…はあ…
やれやれ 今度こそ大丈夫だろう…

Alright, lads. I think we've finally lost them.

yatsu rada…!
さっさと倒すぞ！

sassato taosu zo!

konomama oshi touru!

あんなふざけた連中だったとは…

masaka dasukukurisutaru no bainin ga / annafuzaketa renchuu dattatoha…

確かに…
逃げることにかけては機転が利くようだ

Charlatans? One might argue that a merchant is
naught but a mummer without his motley.
tashikani… / nige rukotonikaketeha kiten ga kiku youda

I won't let them get away like this.

konomama niga shihashinaisa

数ある遺跡のひとつとしか思っていなかった

To think there could have been a Mothercrystal
here in Rosaria all this time.
The wars that could have been avoided...

あの辺りは険しい岩山に囲まれているらしい

From what Father told me long ago,
that area is said to be surrounded by steep rocky mountains.

We still don't know what's in there, Clive,
but whatever it is, there is a good reason
it has gone unnoticed for so long.

Let's get as close to the tower as we can.
There may be a path onward from The Dim somewhere.

had occasion to pick their way through the rocks,
even before the Blight swallowed them.

奴らをぶちのめして逃げられないようにしてやれ！
クリスタルをいただくぞ！

Beat them senseless so they can't get away!
We're taking the Crystal!

I'll carve you like a suckling pig
and feed you to your fucking dog.
yatsu rawobuchinomeshite nige rarenaiyounishiteyare! / kurisutaru woitadakuzo!
面倒なことを！

mendou nakotowo!

renchuu maasa no yado ni muka ttato omou ka？

sasugani hitome ha sake rudarou

tonareba shitchi no oku nohoudana…

kokode yatou no aite woshiteitemo kiri ganai

Around here...

kono atari nihaaa

いないみたいだ

inaimitaida / saki wo isoga naito

mahou ganaito koumo tatakai zuraika…!

I'll manage.
demo yarushikanai…!
ジョシュア？
Joshua?

joshua？

areha…!？ kono mamono kurisutaru ga…!？

naze mamono no karada ni kurisutaru ga…

kuroi mamono ni kurisutaru wo umekoma reta mamono… / kokode nani ga okonawa reteitanda…

kokonimo takusanno souchi ga…

mattakuuu

After crossing to the Wind continent, they pulled carts loaded with their belongings and rested in tents.
Sometimes they took up farming in that land, sometimes they made their living by trade...

And so we wandered, pulling our worldly goods in battered carts,
and sleeping beneath the stars. If the tides carried us to unclaimed soil,
we tilled it. If not, we traded our meager possessions with the locals.
kaze no tairiku ni watatsu tekaraha kazai wo nose ta niguruma wohiki tento de yasumu / tokini hasono chi no nousaku ni tazusawa ri tokini ha akinai de miwo tate ru…

こうして各地を転々としながらも 水の民は伝統を重んじ
水と自然に祈りを捧げ暮らしていました

Even as they moved from place to place, the Motes of Water honored their traditions
and lived offering prayers to water and nature.
But never did we settle in any one place. We became what we had always considered ourselves to be—a river, forever flowing, forever meandering across the land.
koushite kakuchi wo tenten toshinagaramo mizu no tami ha dentou wo omon ji / mizu to shizen ni inori wo sasage kurashi teimashita

ですが 我らの信仰はグエリゴール全教と相容れず
ザンブレク皇国の建国に乗じた“異端狩り”の標的にされたのです

But our faith was incompatible with the Greagorian church,
and we became the target of the "heretic hunts" that took advantage of the founding of the empire of Sanbreque.

Yet our river did not always flow freely. In Sanbreque, we found ourselves hunted by the Greagorian clergy, who labored to rid their inchoate empire of each and every heretic who dared to set foot there.
desuga warera no shinkou ha guerigooru zenkyou to aiire zu / zanbureku koukoku no kenkoku ni jouji ta “ itan kari ” no hyouteki nisaretanodesu

これにより 多くの同胞の命が失われました
水の民は滅びたといわれているのも それゆえです

Because of this, many of our kin lost their lives.
That is also why the Motes of Water are said to have perished.

Their cullings came close to staying our river's course,
but despite their claims of victory, we godless barbarians
survived, albeit in fewer numbers.
koreniyori ooku no douhou no inochi ga ushinawa remashita / mizu no tami ha horobi tatoiwareteirunomo soreyuedesu

その後長く厳しい放浪生活の末 ようやく辿り着いた地―
それがここ ミシディアなのです

Then, after a long and harsh wandering life, the place they finally reached...
that is here, Mysidia.
And after many more years of wandering, of suffering, we finally found our way here to Mysidia. Our new home. Our Haven.
sono nochi nagaku ikameshii hourou seikatsu no matsu youyaku tadori tsui ta chii / soregakoko mishidia nanodesu
かつて水の民は  ふたつの秘術を手に入れました
Long ago, the Motes of Water came by two secret arts.
So the Tributary told you of our people's discoveries. Those that offered us hope, and delivered despair...
katsute mizu no tami ha futatsuno hijutsu wo teniire mashita

ひとつは 人の手でマザークリスタルをつくり出す秘術
もうひとつは 時を止める魔法 フリーズです

One was the secret art of creating a Mothercrystal by human hands.
The other was Freeze... the magic that stops time.
The first was the dusken heart—a long-lost secret my ancestors stumbled upon during their wanderings.
hitotsuha nin no tede mazaakurisutaru wotsukuri dasu hijutsu / mouhitotsuha toki wo yameru mahou furiizu desu

人の手でマザークリスタルをつくり出す秘術は
空の文明の遺跡で偶然手に入れたものでした

The secret art of creating a Mothercrystal by human hands
was something they happened upon in the ruins of the Fallen.
An ancient ruin revealed to them how the Fallen had experimented with crafting their own Mothercrystals, using living beings capable of channeling vast quantities of aether to serve as the hearts.
nin no tede mazaakurisutaru wotsukuri dasu hijutsu ha / sora no bunmei no iseki de guuzen teniire tamonodeshita

それは 体内に多くのエーテルを持つ生物を
マザークリスタルのコアとして代用するというもの

It was a means of substituting a creature that carries great Aether within its body
for the core of a Mothercrystal.
Of course, my ancestors had not the strength to capture such a creature, nor the means to bind it to their will...had the heavens not provided them with the perfect test subject.
soreha tainai ni ooku no eeteru wo motsu seibutsu wo / mazaakurisutaru no koa toshite daiyou surutoiumono

もっとも そんな膨大な力を持った生物が
簡単に見つかることなどなかったようですが…

Though it seems a creature with such immense power
was never easily found...
They convinced themselves that they could create an artificial heart of their own using Waljas as a seed—and reaped their just reward.
mottomo sonna boudai na chikara wo motsu ta seibutsu ga / kantan ni mitsu karukotonadonakattayoudesuga…

同じころ 先祖たちはこの地で 北部の魔女と出会います
そして彼女を介抱するなかで ある魔法を知ったのです

Around the same time, our ancestors met the Witch of the North in this land.
And as they tended to her, they learned of a certain magic.
The second was the means to stop time, taught us by the forsaken witch.
onaji koro senzo tachihakono chi de hokubu no majo to deai masu / soshite kanojo wo kaihou surunakade aru mahou wo shitsu tanodesu

それが《フリーズ》…北部のマザークリスタル・ドレイクアイの
消滅を防ぐために 魔女が編み出した大いなる秘術でした

That was Freeze... a great secret art the Witch devised
to prevent the destruction of Drake's Eye, the Mothercrystal of the North.
She had crafted the spell to cast upon Drake's Eye, that the Northern Territories might forever bask in its blessing. To this end, she built her Vare in the Aire of Hours—too late, as it proved.
sorega << furiizu >>… hokubu no mazaakurisutaru・doreikuai no / shoumetsu wo fusegu tameni majo ga ami dashi ta ooi naru hijutsu deshita

奇しくもこのミシディアで完成していたフリーズは
時の祭殿にある“要”と共に 先祖たちの手に渡ったのです

By strange chance, Freeze... already perfected here in Mysidia...
passed into our ancestors' hands together with the "keystone" in the Aire of Hours.

And for her failure, they exiled her here, knowing she was not long for this world, her body all but consumed by the curse. Little did they suspect that she would survive just long enough to welcome the first settlers of our tribe, and teach to them her magicks.
kushikumo kono mishidia de kanseishi teita furiizu ha / tokino saiden niaru “ you ” to tomoni senzo tachino teni watatsu tanodesu

それからまもなく 一族にワレアス様がお生まれになりました
ワレアス様がドミナントであることに気づいた先祖たちは――

Soon after, Waljas-sama was born into the clan.
And when our ancestors realized that Waljas-sama was a Dominant...

With Waljas's birth, they believed they had everything they needed to revive their fortunes. They would provoke him into priming, then freeze him in time, thus creating a ceaseless fountainhead of aether around which a crystalline tower would rise.
sorekaramamonaku ichizoku ni wareasu sama gao umare ninarimashita / wareasu sama ga dominanto dearukotoni kizu ita senzo tachihaaa

彼こそがマザークリスタルのコアになりうる存在だと確信し
ふたつの秘術ならばそれが叶えられるはずだ と考えました

they were certain she was the one who could become the core of a Mothercrystal,
and reasoned that with the two secret arts, it should be within reach.
The rest, you know. Their foolish plan produced not a single shard, only the near destruction of everything they held dear and the removal of a son of the Motes of Water from the stream of life.
kare kosoga mazaakurisutaru no koa ninariuru sonzai dato kakushin shi / futatsuno hijutsu narabasorega kanae rareruhazuda to kangae mashita

ですがそれは ワレアス様が持つ膨大なエーテルを引き出したまま
“時の流れ”を止めるという 恐ろしい発想だったのです…

But it was a terrifying notion: to draw forth the vast Aether Waljas-sama holds and leave it drawn,
and so to stop the "flow of time"...

Not that it could ever have succeeded. It was a plan born of desperation, not consideration—for if the history of our people has taught us anything, it is that we do not need crystals to survive, only each other.
desugasoreha wareasu sama ga motsu boudai na eeteru wo hikidashi tamama / “ tokino nagare ” wo yameru toiu osoroshii hassou dattanodesu…

80年ほど前 ワレアス様を生贄に行われたのは…
マザークリスタルのコアをつくり出すための儀式です
Some eighty years ago, the rite for which Waljas-sama was offered as a sacrifice... was performed to create a Mothercrystal's core.

Eighty years have come and gone since our people took it
into their heads to try and transform that poor child into
the heart of a Mothercrystal.
80 nen hodo mae wareasu sama wo ikenie ni okonawa retanoha… / mazaakurisutaru no koa wotsukuri dasu tameno gishiki desu

ネプト岬が祭場として選ばれ
そこに ワレアス様を祀りあげる祭壇が設けられました

Cape Nepto was chosen as the site of the rite,
and there an altar was raised to enshrine Waljas-sama.
They erected an altar upon Cape Nepto especially for the purpose.
neputo misaki ga saijou toshite eraba re / sokoni wareasu sama wo matsuri ageru saidan ga mouke raremashita

海を分かつ岬は 水の民にとって決断の地であるとともに
フリーズを射当てる場所としても 絶好の地だったそうです

The cape that parts the sea is a place of decision for the Motes of Water, and
I am told it was also an ideal place from which to strike with Freeze.

They claimed the site was chosen for its religious significance—the way the promontory divided the sea representing the break in our history that the Mothercrystal would usher in. But if you ask me, its distance from the village and the clear line of sight between it and the Aire of Hours counted just as heavily in its favor.
umi wo waka tsu misaki ha mizu no tami nitotte ketsudan no chi dearutotomoni / furiizu wo sha ate ru basho toshitemo zekkou no chi dattasoudesu

儀式では ワレアス様からエーテルを強引に引き出したといいます
遺跡で得たという黒い肉を用いた 奇妙な薬を使って…

They say that in the rite, Aether was forcibly drawn from Waljas-sama,
with a strange drug made from black flesh said to have been taken from the ruins...

The plan was simple: they would feed some manner of grisly offering to Waljas which they believed could draw out his latent powers, then freeze him in time using the witch's spell, that he might serve as a constant conduit for aether.
gishiki deha wareasu sama kara eeteru wo gouin ni hikidashi tatoiimasu / iseki de eta toiu kuroi niku wo mochiita kimyou na kusuri wo tsukatte…

その結果 ワレアス様の力は暴走…
リヴァイアサンに顕現し 激しい大波を起こしました

As a result, Waljas-sama's power ran wild...
and he manifested as Leviathan, raising violent waves.
Sadly for them, the first part worked rather too well. Whatever the nature of that evil concoction, it brought forth Leviathan, who raged and roiled as only a discomfited infant can.
sono kekka wareasu youno chikara ha bousou… / rivaiasan ni kengen shi hageshii oonami wo oko shimashita

慌てた先祖たちは ワレアス様の“時”を止めるためではなく
リヴァイアサンの暴走を鎮めるためにフリーズを放ったのです

In their alarm, the ancestors loosed Freeze... not to stop Waljas-sama's "time",
but to quell Leviathan's rampage.

Every soul on the cape was killed in an instant. Mysidia would have been lost to the waves entirely were it not for the second party on the mountain, who wove the witch's spell as fast as their trembling hands would let them.
awate ta senzo tachiha wareasu youno “ toki ” wo yameru tamedehanaku / rivaiasan no bousou wo tsutsushime rutameni furiizu wo houtsutsu tanodesu

やがて顕現が解けたワレアス様の姿は…止まった時の中で
“膨大なエーテルを湛える塊”となっていました

In the end, once the manifestation had broken, Waljas-sama's form... there within the stopped time,
had become "a mass brimming with vast Aether."

It drove the Eikon back into Waljas's body, where it has
remained, channeling aether through the poor child's
semi-primed form, ever since.
yagate kengen ga toke ta wareasu youno sugata ha… toma tta tokino naka de / “ boudai na eeteru wo tatae ru kai ” tonatteimashita

ですが それはマザークリスタルのコアと程遠い代物でした
先祖たちは大きな犠牲を払い 己の過ちを悟ったのです

But it was far from a Mothercrystal's core.
The ancestors paid a great price, and came to see their own mistake.
And yet...their ill-begotten "heart" never did create a single shard of crystal—for our ancestor's plan was doomed from the first, whatever they may have told themselves.
desuga soreha mazaakurisutaru no koa to hodotooi shiromono deshita / senzo tachiha ooki na gisei wo harai onore no ayamachi wo satotsu tanodesu

ワレアス様をマザークリスタルのコアにする儀式は
当時の族長を中心とする 長老たちの手で推し進められました

The ritual to make Waljas-sama the core of the Mothercrystal
was driven forward by the elders, with the clan chief of that time at their head.
It was the Tributary of the time, together with his council of elders, who agitated for Waljas's sacrifice.
wareasu sama wo mazaakurisutaru no koa nisuru gishiki ha / touji no zokuchou wo chuushin tosuru chourou tachino tede oshisusume raremashita

民の多くは 生まれたばかりの赤子を犠牲にすることを拒みましたが
苦しい生活からの解放という大義を盾に 強行されてしまったのです

Many of the people refused to sacrifice a newborn child,
but it was forced through behind the shield of a noble cause: release from their hardship.
Naturally, there were many dissenting voices...but with his own father in favor—convinced as he was that it was the only way to save his people—they were soon drowned out.
tami no ooku ha umare tabakarino akago wo gisei nisurukotowo kobami mashitaga / kurushii seikatsu karano kaihou toiu taigi wo tate ni kyoukou sareteshimattanodesu

ですが儀式は失敗し 族長たちは権威を失いました
誰もが幼い犠牲を悔やむとともに この愚かな行いを恥じたそうです

But the ritual failed, and the clan chiefs lost their authority.
They say everyone grieved the young sacrifice, and was ashamed of this foolish deed.

Thus the plan went ahead, and Waljas was sacrificed for naught, at the loss of countless lives. Yet, by some miracle, the Tributary's was not among them. So he surrendered himself to the people's judgment for the terrible wrong he'd done.
desuga gishiki ha shippai shi zokuchou tachiha ken'i wo ushinai mashita / daremo ga osanai gisei wo kuya mutotomoni kono oroka na okonai wo haji tasoudesu

その罪滅ぼしとして水の民は 苦しい生活が続いても
ワレアス様を見守り続けることを選びました

In atonement for that sin, the Motes of Water resolved that even if hardship went on,
they would keep watch over Waljas-sama.

And they pardoned him. Even the loudest voices that had
spoken out against the plan wished only for Waljas's release,
and demanded that we all continue to watch over him till
a means could be found to effect it.
sono tsumihoroboshi toshite mizu no tami ha kurushii seikatsu ga tsuzui temo / wareasu sama wo mimamori tsuzuke rukotowo erabi mashita

そしていつの日か あのお方をフリーズから解放するときのため
当代に至るまで 秘術のことを伝え残してきたのです

And so that one day she might be freed from Freeze,
they have handed down the secret art, all the way to our present generation.
So here we have remained. Waiting for the day when we might finally atone for our ancestors' sins.
soshiteitsuno nichi ka anoo houwo furiizu kara kaihou surutokinotame / toudai ni itaru made hijutsu nokotowo tsutae nokoshi tekitanodesu

しかし フリーズを解く手段が残されてはいるものの
ワレアス様が再び顕現してしまう恐れもあり…

Yet though the means to undo Freeze has been left to us,
there is also the fear that Waljas-sama may manifest again...
We knew the secret to unraveling the spell that bound him from the first...but doing so meant unleashing Leviathan, and that would be the death of us all, Waljas included.
shikashi furiizu wo toku shudan ga nokosa retehairumonono / wareasu sama ga futatabi kengen shiteshimau osore moari…

皆 あのお方を救いたいと切に願いながらも
強大な力に手が出せぬまま 今に至っているのです

Everyone longs to save her, and yet
they cannot reach that immense power, and so it stands to this day.
Our only hope was to find a means to quell the Eikon's rage, without exposing our secret to the outside world. Our only hope...is you.
mina anoo houwo sukui taito setsuni negai nagaramo / kyoudai na chikara ni tega dase numama ima ni itatsu teirunodesu

これからも 私はシュラ様を支えていくつもりです
ただし その役割は少し変わっていくかもしれません

I intend to keep supporting Shula-sama from now on as well.
Though that role of mine may change somewhat.
I will continue to support Lady Shula however I can. Now that she has Waljas to care for, I expect I shall be even busier than before.
korekaramo watashi ha shura sama wo sasae teikutsumoridesu / tadashi sono yakuwari ha sukoshi kawa tteikukamoshiremasen

シュラ様には ワレアス様の養育という新たな務めができました
乳母となる者の支えがあるとはいえ 片手間にはできないこと…

Shula-sama has taken on a new duty: the raising of Waljas-sama.
Even with a wet nurse to help, it is not a task for spare moments...
It has been generations since last we raised a Dominant of Leviathan, and it is a great responsibility for anyone to bear.
shura youni ha wareasu youno youiku toiu arata na tsutome gadekimashita / uba tonaru mono no sasae gaarutohaie katatema nihadekinaikoto…

ですから私は シュラ様の族長としての務めを
これまで以上に手助けしてゆきたいと考えているのです

So I mean to help Shula-sama with her duties as clan chief
more than I ever have before.

But Lady Shula will not have to bear it alone.
Supporting her means supporting them both.
desukara watashi ha shura youno zokuchou toshiteno tsutome wo / koremade ijou ni tedasuke shiteyukitaito kangae teirunodesu

ワレアス様をお救いすることができたとはいえ
私たち水の民には 向き合うべきことが山のようにあります

We were able to save Waljas-sama, it is true,
but we Motes of Water have mountains of matters to face.
It also means preparing for our reentry into the outside world. We have not the crystals to sustain the glamour for many more moons.
wareasu sama woo sukui surukotogadekitatohaie / watashitachi mizu no tami niha muki au bekikotoga yama noyouniarimasu

外界へと里を開いていくこと 消えゆくミラージュのこと
この地に残ったネプトの波浪壁やフリーズのこと…

Opening the village to the outside world, the Mirage fading away,
the Surge and Freeze left behind in this land...
Inevitably, there will be those who resist the idea. Our history gives us ample reason to fear life beyond the wall. And that was before we had Waljas and the Vare.
gaikai heto sato wo hirai teikukoto kie yuku miraaju nokoto / kono chi ni nokotsu ta neputo no harou kabe ya furiizu nokoto…

そしてワレアス様を…リヴァイアサンのドミナントを
もう何者にも利用されることのないよう お守りしていくこと

And watching over Waljas-sama... over the Dominant of Leviathan,
so that no one may ever use him again.
But change is coming, whether we like it or not. Troubled waters lie ahead, through which Lady Shula must try to steer a course.
soshite wareasu sama wo… rivaiasan no dominanto wo / mou nanimono nimo riyou sarerukotononaiyou o mamori shiteikukoto

それらすべてを シュラ様だけに押し付けたくはないのです
共に歩み 支えたい…それが私の望みですから

I do not wish to push all of it onto Shula-sama alone.
I want to walk beside her and support her... that is my wish.
And steer one she shall, with me to provide a steadying hand on the tiller, if ever she should need it.
sorerasubetewo shura sama dakeni oshitsuke takuhanainodesu / tomoni ayumi sasae tai… sorega watashi no nozomi desukara

滅びたはずの水の民に 伝説のリヴァイアサン…
まさか彼らと関わる日がくるとはね…驚いたよ

The Motes of Water, who should have perished, and the legendary Leviathan...
To think the day would come when I'd have dealings with them... I'm surprised.

Journeying through Mysidia was like visiting another world.
A world in which the Motes of Water yet endured, and
Leviathan the Lost was found.
horobi tahazuno mizu no tami ni densetsu no rivaiasan… / masaka karera to kakawa ru nichi gakurutohane… odoroi tayo

この出会いのおかげで ワレアスを解放することができた
シュラたちのもとであれば これからは元気に育ってくれるはずさ

Thanks to this encounter, we were able to free Waljas.
With Shula and the others, she should grow up healthy now.
Not that everything there was so divorced from our own reality. Waljas's imprisonment seemed quite of a piece.
kono deai nookagede wareasu wo kaihou surukotogadekita / shura tachinomotodeareba korekaraha genki ni sodatsu tekureruhazusa

今の水の民のような クリスタルを手放しつつある暮らしは
これからのヴァリスゼアが辿る未来と言えるだろう

A life like that of the Motes of Water now, slowly letting go of the Crystals...
you could say that is the future Valisthea will follow.
For is it not the fate of every Dominant? To be the servant of the nation in which they are born, or else the slave? No matter their fears, their pain, or their suffering.
ima no mizu no tami noyouna kurisutaru wo tebanashi tsutsuaru kurashi ha / korekarano varisuzea ga tadoru mirai to ie rudarou

人は 魔法がなくても生きていける
それを改めて 彼らに教えてもらった気がするよ

People can live without magic.
I feel they taught me that all over again.

Waljas's torment differed only in its means and severity.
But now it is at an end. He is free at last to live.
nin ha mahou ganakutemo iki teikeru / sorewo aratame te karera ni oshie temoratta kiga suruyo

兄さん…必ずアルテマを倒そう
人がクリスタルに翻弄される世界は もう終わりにしなければ

Nii-san... let's be sure to defeat Ultima.
We have to put an end to a world where people are at the mercy of the Crystals.

And so it falls to us to create a world where every man, woman,
and child can do the same, no matter the blessings or the burdens
with which they are born.
niisan… kanarazu arutema wo taoso u / nin ga kurisutaru ni honrou sareru sekai ha mou owari nishinakereba

先代のシヴァのドミナント… ミシディアでの旅で
彼女の痕跡を辿ることになるとは思わなかったわ

The previous Shiva's Dominant... I never thought that, on our journey through Mysidia,
we would end up following her traces.
I've been thinking about our time in Mysidia. We were there to save Waljas and help redeem the Motes of Water.
sendai no shiva no dominanto… mishidia deno tabi de / kanojo no konseki wo tadoru kotoninarutoha omowa nakattawa

クライヴ…
彼女はどんな想いで《フリーズ》を編み出したんだと思う？

Clive...
What do you suppose she was feeling when she devised Freeze?

But what of Shiva's Dominant? What of her legacy?
Her redemption?
kuraivu… / kanojo hadonna omoi de << furiizu >> wo ami dashi tandato omou？

私がエーテルに触れて感じたのは 人々の幸せへの願い
決して誰かを苦しめるためのものじゃない…

What I felt when I touched the Aether was a wish for people's happiness.
Never something meant to make anyone suffer...
She sacrificed everything to conjure a spell that might provide her people a better future. I doubt she would have wanted to see those magicks used to rob an innocent child of that very thing.
watashi ga eeteru ni furete kanji tanoha hitobito no shiawase heno negai / kesshite dareka wo kurushi merutamenomonojanai…

あの日 ワレアスやシュラを縛っていたフリーズは解かれ
水の民はようやく未来へと歩き出すことができたわ

That day, the Freeze that bound Waljas and Shula was undone,
and the Motes of Water could finally begin to walk toward the future.
When we calmed the Vare that day, we righted two wrongs.
ano nichi wareasu ya shura wo shibatsu teita furiizu ha toka re / mizu no tami hayouyaku mirai heto aruki dasu kotogadekitawa

“もうひとりのシヴァ”の想いも きっと解き放たれたと…
